hooks.logic:
Reset the count "intervalTurnsCount".
Queue the pose-change sequence [[{messageSuffixNo: "01"}]].
Put queued moves ahead of counters.

flow.text: Put queued moves ahead of counters.

hooks.logic:
If condition flag "CONDITION_FLAG_TAG_ABILITY_DONE" is up this frame, then
  Let v be run helper.
  Let paramSuffixNo be list at v's 'paramSuffixNo'.
  Let paramIdBySuffixNo be the stat block of form paramSuffixNo on the enemy.
  The enemy changes to stat block paramIdBySuffixNo.
  Choose state 11 next.
  Set the script register's 'currentBpConfsIndex' to v and stop.
If the enemy is ready to act, then the enemy → without-and-lot-and-register-ability with ({forceIgnoresReflection: false}).

script_hooks.logic:
Let hpRate be the HP fraction of the enemy.
Let currentBpConfsIndex be the script register's 'currentBpConfsIndex'.
Return the phase for the enemy under the phases list with HP fraction hpRate from phase currentBpConfsIndex.

flow.text: Let hpRate be the HP fraction of the enemy.

script_hooks.logic:
Count up "intervalTurnsCount".
If the numeric entry "turns_of_giga_flare_interval" in the battle settings of the group of the enemy is less than the count "intervalTurnsCount", then choose state 15 next and stop.
Let currentBpConfsIndex be the script register's 'currentBpConfsIndex'.
Let v be run helper.
If currentBpConfsIndex is less than v, then
  Let paramSuffixNo be list at v's 'paramSuffixNo'.
  Let paramIdBySuffixNo be the stat block of form paramSuffixNo on the enemy.
  The enemy cancels its cast.
  The enemy changes to stat block paramIdBySuffixNo.
  Set the script register's 'currentBpConfsIndex' to v and stop.
If the enemy is ready to act, then the enemy → without-and-lot-and-register-ability with ({forceIgnoresReflection: false}).
